observations: Photo 0: Front view of a black LG monitor on a wooden surface. The screen is off. The LG logo is visible at the bottom center. The bezel is thin, but not completely frameless. The stand is a single pedestal base.

Photo 1: Rear view of the same monitor. The LG logo is visible at the top center. A white energy label is affixed to the back, showing model number '22MP57VQ'. The stand is attached to the back panel. There are some minor scuffs and marks on the plastic casing.
Photo 2: Front view from a slightly different angle, showing the same monitor. The screen is off. The bezel appears consistent with photo 0. The stand is visible from the front.
The monitor is placed in a cluttered environment with other electronics and boxes around it.
No cables, power adapter, or accessories are visible in any photo.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 2 show a visible bezel around the screen, especially at the top and bottom. The term 'frameless' is inaccurate; it is a slim-bezel monitor. The model 22MP57VQ is known to have a bezel, not frameless design.
All photos show the screen turned off. There is no visual evidence of the monitor being powered on or displaying an image. No video or live test is provided.
Warranty is a service claim that cannot be verified from photos. No warranty document, receipt, or proof of purchase is shown. The seller's statement alone is insufficient.

risks.risk: Monitor may not be functional (e.g., dead pixels, backlight failure, no signal)
risks.proof: A video clip showing the monitor powered on, displaying a test pattern or connected to a PC, with clear image and no defects.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power cable, HDMI/VGA cable, stand base if detachable)
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the monitor.

risks.risk: Physical damage not visible in photos (e.g., cracked screen, internal damage, loose connections)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the screen surface under bright light to check for cracks or dead pixels, and a video of the monitor being powered on and rotated to check for flickering or lines.

proof_requests: Video showing the monitor powered on and displaying a clear image.
Photo of all included accessories (cables, power adapter, stand base).
Close-up photo of the screen surface under bright light to check for damage or dead pixels.
response.reason: The monitor's model is identified as LG 22MP57VQ, but the 'frameless' claim is contradicted by visible bezels. The 'working perfectly fine' claim is unverified as the screen is off in all photos. Warranty is unverifiable remotely. Without proof of functionality and included accessories, the item cannot be priced accurately. The next step is to request video and photos proving it works and what is included.
